title: The starter templates, including the coming soon equipment starter
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A new template open at the starting-point screen; and an existing template being edited so a second section can be added.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the starter library offers six slots; five carry template content (Class 8 Tractor PM Inspection, DOT / Annual Federal Safety Inspection, Air-Brake Inspection, Trailer Inspection and Light-Duty PM Inspection) built from the five templates shops already run, each card an icon and a name only, with no second line.
2. Confirm the sixth slot is the equipment starter — a pending placeholder (dashed border, PENDING badge), not pickable — and the grid is equal rows so a seventh/eighth entry drop in without relayout.
3. Add a section after the first and confirm it offers field types only, not starting points.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The starter library offers six slots; five carry template content (Class 8 Tractor PM Inspection, DOT / Annual Federal Safety Inspection, Air-Brake Inspection, Trailer Inspection and Light-Duty PM Inspection), each card carrying an icon and a name only, with no second line.
  • The sixth slot is the equipment starter — a pending placeholder (dashed border, PENDING badge) that is not pickable — and the grid is built as equal rows so a seventh and eighth entry drop in without relayout.
  • A section added after the first offers field types only, not starting points.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R4: “The starter library will offer six slots. Five carry template content, built from the five templates the shops already run: Class 8 Tractor PM Inspection, DOT / Annual Federal Safety Inspection, Air-Brake Inspection, Trailer Inspection and Light-Duty PM Inspection. Starters are verified visually, one to one, against the output of the extension they come from. A starter card carries an icon and a name only; the name describes the template, and a second line repeating it was removed”
  • S12-R5: “The sixth slot is the equipment starter, which was asked for in review and has no name or content yet. It renders as a pending placeholder — dashed border, PENDING badge — and is not pickable. The grid is built as equal rows so a seventh and eighth entry drop in without relayout”
  • S12-R7: “A section added after the first will offer field types only, not starting points, because a starting point creates a whole template”

Amended on 13 October 2026
S12-R4 changed after 22 September 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, read on 13 October 2026): it gives the starters' full names, no longer lists section and field counts, and says the starters are verified visually against the extension's output. The quote above is the current wording; step 1 and the expected results use the full names.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
